# Disabled upstream workflows

These workflows are preserved from Pi for upstream comparison but are outside GitHub's active `.github/workflows/` directory.

CozyClay keeps only the generic CI workflow active during bootstrap. Release publishing, model-catalog uploads, contributor gates, issue automation, and scheduled audits must remain disabled until this repository defines its own credentials, destinations, permissions, and maintenance policy.

When syncing Pi, do not move these files back automatically. Review each workflow as product code before enabling it.
